display.title: Lane: Magic
display.subtitle: Cultivate your way up
description: The Magic lane mirrors Engineering, but draws ONLY from the peaceful
side of the arcane arts: mana farms, source generation, and rituals.
Never spellcasting - this is the cultivator's road.
Crystallized reagents (manasteel, source gems, terrasteel...) are the
'ore'; milestone altars and rituals are the 'machines'.
Tiered: Botania at T1, Ars Nouveau at T2, advanced Botania + Occultism
§7See the Magic group in this quest book.

see_lane.title: Acquire a Botania mystical petal to begin Magic
